title: q_salary lacks the empty-datum fallback that every sibling as-stated copy function has
detail: Sibling as-stated copy functions (q_works_at, q_employment_period, q_role) branch on an empty datum to an open variant; q_salary does not, so a missing salary datum renders "salary is € a year" — broken copy under the module's own stated contract.
recommended_fix: Branch on vars.annual_salary like the siblings: add an open-question variant for the empty case (or prove the registry can never call q_salary with "").

title: Amount input field name derivation differs between AmountOrDontRemember and AsStatedAmount
evidence:
AmountOrDontRemember ->
      html.div([], [
        view_amount_field(qv, "a_" <> q.id),
---
    AsStatedAmount ->
      html.div([], [
        view_options_named(
          "a_" <> q.id <> "_choice",
---
        view_amount_field(qv, "a_" <> q.id <> "_amount"),
detail: Every sibling field in both amount controls carries a suffix (_choice, _dont_remember, _amount); only AmountOrDontRemember's amount field is a bare a_<id>. Server-side parsing must handle two naming conventions for the same semantic.
recommended_fix: Name AmountOrDontRemember's amount field consistently (e.g. a_<id>_amount) and align the server-side parser.

title: Hard-coded data-testid "reference-input-dont_remember" ignores the question id
evidence:
view_checkbox(
          qv,
          field: "a_" <> q.id <> "_dont_remember",
          label: form_copy.dont_remember_label,
          testid: "reference-input-dont_remember",
        ),
---
      attribute("data-testid", "reference-input-" <> field),
detail: Every other control derives its testid from the question id or field name; this one is a fixed literal, so a second AmountOrDontRemember question would emit duplicate testids, and the id-less testid under-specifies which input it targets.
recommended_fix: Derive the testid from the question id like its siblings, e.g. "reference-input-" <> q.id <> "_dont_remember".
